$comment: AndroidX sample FILES this catalog cannot compile against the Compose Multiplatform desktop artifacts, each with its reason. A declared gap rather than a silent one: scripts/import-samples.mjs skips these, and deleting an entry and re-running the import + `./gradlew :catalog:compileKotlin` is how to tell whether it is still needed. The first fourteen are yschimke/m3-catalog's ui-samples-catalog/quarantine.json, carried over verbatim (same pin, same artifacts). The rest were added from the first compile of the wider corpus here; the error counts are what that compile reported. An entry keys on the bare `file` name unless that name repeats across libraries, when it names the vendored `path`.
$comment_kinds: Three kinds. ANDROID-SPECIFIC (an Activity, a View, a Context, android.*) and ANDROID RESOURCES (R.drawable / R.font / R.string — a desktop module has no Android resource table) are the steady state. VERSION SKEW is temporary: AndroidX 1.12.0 has an API the Compose Multiplatform artifact of the same line does not ship yet, so when the CMP pin moves, re-run the import without the entry. Where one API takes out a file whose other samples are fine, the entry says so: a patch in catalog/patches/ is the better fix.

samples.reason: 159 errors: `androidx.activity.ComponentActivity`, `onCreate`, `setContent`, `WindowCompat` and `android.os.Bundle`. Every sample in the file is an Activity subclass demonstrating edge-to-edge insets, which is a statement about the Android window and has no desktop equivalent at all.
36 errors: the same Activity-and-`WindowCompat` shape as WindowInsetsPaddingSample.kt, for the inset SIZE modifiers.
2 errors: `Modifier.imeNestedScroll`, which drives the Android soft keyboard as it animates. Android-only by construction — there is no IME to scroll with.

69 errors: `android.content.ClipData`, `ClipDescription`, `Intent` and `toAndroidDragEvent`. Compose's drag-and-drop surface is platform-typed and these samples are written against the Android payload.
53 errors: `AndroidExternalSurface` and `AndroidEmbeddedExternalSurface`, plus `android.graphics.Rect` and `Surface.lockCanvas`. Android-only by name as well as by API.
11 errors: the `TransferableContent` receive-content surface, whose payload is an Android `ClipData` and whose `consume` overload the multiplatform artifact does not carry.
6 errors: `ProcessTextKey`, `stringResource` and `R` — an Android text-processing intent and a resource table, neither of which exists on the desktop renderer.
4 errors: `Modifier.magnifier` and an `android.os.Build` version gate. The magnifier is a platform widget the Android framework draws.
4 errors: `Modifier.handwritingDetector` and `Modifier.handwritingHandler`, the stylus handwriting surface the Android IME provides.

2 errors: `android.util.Log`, called from the click handler. Small enough to be a patch on its face — and a patch would edit what the sample DOES, since the logging call is the whole body of the click it demonstrates. Revisit when upstream stops logging from a sample.
3 errors: `LocalBackgroundTextMeasurementExecutor`, an AndroidX 1.12 composition local Compose Multiplatform 1.12.0 does not ship. Version skew, expected to disappear when the CMP pin moves.

1 error after the FlexBox opt-ins: `maxItemsInEachLine` on `FlexBox`, which AndroidX 1.12.0 has and the Compose Multiplatform artifact of the same version does not. Version skew, and the reason the opt-ins are worth keeping: they are what reduced 336 errors to this one, and they will be needed the moment the skew closes.

1 error: `cacheWindow`, a LazyGrid parameter added in AndroidX 1.12.0 and absent from Compose Multiplatform 1.12.0. Version skew. The whole file goes for one parameter, which is the per-file cost this list's header warns about — a patch would mean deleting an argument from a sample whose subject is arguably that argument.
1 error: the same `cacheWindow` skew as LazyGridSamples.kt.
1 error: `DeferredTargetAnimation.value`, which AndroidX 1.12.0 has and Compose Multiplatform 1.12 does not ship.

7 errors: `rememberDeferredTransition` (AndroidX 1.12.0 only) and `Modifier.systemGestureExclusion`, an Android window-insets API. Named by `path` because `animation` has a `TransitionSamples.kt` too.
4 errors: `animatedVectorResource` and `R.drawable.*`: an Android animated-vector XML resource, which a desktop module has no resource table for.
4 errors: `rememberDeferredTransition`, which AndroidX 1.12.0 has and Compose Multiplatform 1.12 does not ship. One API takes the whole file — a candidate for a patch.

9 errors: `CapturedAnimatedVisibility` and `rememberDeferredTransition`, AndroidX 1.12.0 APIs Compose Multiplatform 1.12 does not ship. A candidate for a patch: most of the file's samples use neither.
4 errors: `EnterTransition.config` / `ExitTransition.config`, absent from Compose Multiplatform 1.12.
24 errors: `R.drawable.*` through `painterResource(id = …)` — an Android resource table — plus `rememberDeferredTransition`.
1 error: `android.graphics.*`, used to draw into a native Android canvas.
11 errors: `asAndroidBitmap`, `openFileOutput` and `android.graphics.*`: the samples write a captured layer to an Android file.
50 errors: `AndroidView` and `android.view.*` — embedding Android Views is the whole subject.
1 error: `R.drawable.*`, an Android resource.
16 errors: `ComposeView` / `ComposeViewContext`, the Android View-system host.
6 errors: `android.os.IBinder` and the `windowToken` / `scrimAlpha` `DialogProperties` parameters, which the desktop `DialogProperties` does not have.
35 errors: `AndroidView` and `rememberNestedScrollInteropConnection`, nested-scroll interop with Android Views.
1 error: `R.drawable.*`, an Android resource.
2 errors: `LocalView`, the Android host View.
8 errors: `android.view.inputmethod.EditorInfo` / `InputConnection`: the Android IME protocol.
5 errors: `PointerEvent.motionEvent` and `android.view.MotionEvent` in two samples. A candidate for a patch: the rest of the file is platform-neutral.
5 errors: `android.os.IBinder` and the `windowToken` / `scrimAlpha` `PopupProperties` parameters, absent on desktop.
4 errors: `LocalContext` and `resources`, to read an Android dimension.
2 errors: `SemanticsPropertyReceiver.hintText`, an AndroidX 1.12.0 semantics property Compose Multiplatform 1.12 does not ship.
7 errors: `Activity`, `LocalContext` and `window`: the Android display frame-rate API.
12 errors: `LocalContext`, `window` and `android.*`: the Android display frame-rate API.
3 errors: `SoundEffectOnInteraction`, absent from Compose Multiplatform 1.12.
1 error: `ExposedDropdownMenu`, which the file resolves against an AndroidX material3 API surface the Compose Multiplatform material3 1.12 alpha does not match.
19 errors: `AnnotatedString` `Saver` APIs the Compose Multiplatform 1.12 `ui-text` does not ship; the remaining errors cascade from them. A candidate for a patch.
5 errors: `AnnotatedString.fromHtml` and `stringResource(R.string.*)`: an Android HTML parser and resource table.
3 errors: `R.font.*`: fonts from the Android resource table.
8 errors: `R.font.*` plus `FontVariation.Settings.merge`, absent from Compose Multiplatform 1.12.
9 errors: `LineBreak.Strategy` / `Strictness` / `WordBreak`, which exist only on the Android `LineBreak` — desktop text has no configurable line-break strategy.

semantics.reason: Android-only card whose render publishes no semantics tree: Design Artifacts run 42214387635 rendered its pixels but the Robolectric semantics capture produced nothing for it ("no semantics for" in the generate step), which refuses the whole catalog. Not root-caused per sample — most are animation-driven (AnimatedVisibility, transitions, shared elements) or Android-host APIs (Magnifier, placement coordinates). The pixels publish; only the a11y/semantics layer is missing. Delete the entry when a render captures a tree again: an exemption that matches nothing is reported on every publish.

$comment_semantics: `semantics` names componentIds (as catalog.spec.json spells them) whose render publishes without a semantics tree. scripts/samples-spec.mjs copies them into the spec's `completeness.exemptSemantics`, so the publish gate reports them instead of refusing the catalog.
